title: Sister Claire Roy Joins Garneau Group
text:
The community mourns the loss of Sister Claire Roy (Sister Ste-Lutgarde), who passed away at the age of 98, after a life dedicated to faith and service. This article provides details about the life of Sister Claire Roy and her contributions to the Nuns of Jesus-Marie de Sillery. Learn more about her remarkable journey, including her family and the details of her service arrangements.
Sister Claire Roy (Sister Ste-Lutgarde) Passes Away at 98 Lévis , Québec – April 16, 2025
A Life Dedicated to Faith Sister Claire Roy, known within her religious community as Sister Ste-Lutgarde, passed away on April 11, 2025, at the age of 98. Her death occurred at the provincial infirmary of the Nuns of Jesus-Marie de Sillery. Sister roy dedicated 75 years of her life to religious service.
Early Life and Family Born in Saint-Vital, Lambton, Sister Roy was the daughter of the late Henri-Louis Roy and Marie-Blanche Lessard . She is survived by her sister, Colette (the late Rodolphe Drapeau), and her brother, Delphis (the late Marie-Paule roy), as well as her sister-in-law, Hugardte Picard (late Rosary). She was preceded in death by her brothers Rosaire, Lucien, Maurice (late Éliane St-Pierre), and her sister Anne-Marie, SCQ.
Service Information The community will receive condolences on Friday, April 25, from 9:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. at the provincial house of the nuns of Jesus-Marie,located at 294 rue Saint-Joseph,Lévis. A religious service will follow at 10:30 a.m. in the chapel of the provincial house.
Remembering Sister Roy Sister Claire Roy’s long life was marked by devotion and service. Her contributions to the Nuns of Jesus-Marie de Sillery will be remembered by her community and family.
Arrangements entrusted to Garneau Group Thanatologist, 418-839-8823, www.groupegarneau.com , Member of the Quebec Thanatologists Corporation.
